title: SimplePractice Session Daily Event Volume
dataSources: SimplePractice therapy sessions (`simplepractice:session`), Headway appointments (`headway:appointment`), BetterHelp sessions (`betterhelp:session`), CBT homework logs (`cbt:homework`), and Daylio mood entries (`daylio:mood`).
app: SimplePractice session notes, Headway appointment confirmations, BetterHelp messaging sessions, CBT homework trackers, and Daylio mood exports ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=simplepractice:session
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(therapist_name) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many SimplePractice therapy session events land each day and how many distinct therapist values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest SimplePractice therapy session records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct therapist values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It warns how much SimplePractice therapy session activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
